title: Basic Calculator II
constraints: The expression is valid; operators are binary and division never uses a zero divisor.
All intermediate results fit in a signed 32-bit integer.
inputFormat: Implement calculate(s), where s is a valid expression of non-negative integer operands, binary +, -, *, / operators, and optional spaces between tokens.
outputFormat: The integer result using standard precedence, left-to-right evaluation for equal-precedence operators, and division truncated toward zero.
